shellCommands.command: cat package.json; git status --short; find app src -type f 2>/dev/null | grep -v node_modules | head -50; cat next.config.* 2>/dev/null; ls node_modules/next/dist/docs/
for f in app/layout.tsx app/page.tsx 'app/projects/[slug]/page.tsx'; do echo "== $f"; cat "$f"; done; grep -rli "prefetch" node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app | head -30
ls lib 2>/dev/null && cat lib/*; cat tsconfig.json; cat node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/02-guides/adopting-partial-prefetching.md

cd node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference; ls 04-functions | grep -i -E "navigation|prefetch"; sed -n 1,200p 04-functions/navigation.md; ls 03-file-conventions/*/ | grep -i prefetch; grep -rl "partialPrefetching" 05-config | head
